caption: The drawing displays a fabric doll positioned upright and centered on a light beige background. The doll has a round, light tan face made from a stitched cloth, featuring hand-sewn details for the eyes, eyebrows, mouth, and nose in dark thread. The hair is depicted with dark stitching covering the top and sides of the head. The doll wears a long-sleeved green blouse with a floral pattern, buttoned at the front. Its skirt is dark brown, wide, and heavy-looking, with some folding and slight flare. Under the skirt, white petticoat lace is visible at the hem. The doll’s hands appear to be made from a brown material, possibly leather, with visible finger separations. The feet are covered with dark, likely black or brown shoes, which are slightly scuffed and have visible seams. The clothing and features of the doll are detailed with varying textures and shades, and the entire figure is set against a plain rectangular background, without any other objects present. At the bottom right, the name "Erwin Starzgl" is faintly written, likely identifying the creator or artist.
title: Rag Doll
